Assam Floods Impact Thousands, Damage Infrastructure

Heavy rainfall has caused significant flooding in Assam, affecting thousands of people and disrupting transportation. Several districts have reported inundation, with reports of bridges damaged and trains halted. Rescue operations are underway, and authorities are mobilizing relief efforts.
